body:
## Why

`set_theme` / `set_theme_system(family)` select a preference, but nothing lets a script learn which variant actually resolved. Skins that compute colors in script (canvas palettes, chart series derived from tokens) cannot follow `*_theme_system`: the chrome switches while their computed colors stay stale. Found while porting tobi/disktree to a rhai skin (disktree-rhai), whose treemap fills are rgba ints computed in rhai and must branch light/dark.

## What

- `UiContext::resolved_theme_variant()` — resolve for the context's window/scope, tracked via `track_theme` so dependent effects re-run on selection or system-appearance changes.
- `ctx.theme_variant()` script method → `#{family, name, mode}` or `()`.
- `motion_tokens()` refactored onto the same resolver (behavior unchanged).
- `docs/theming.md` documents the read next to the setters.
- Unit test: uninstalled → none; installed two-variant family resolves the fixed selection.

## Verification

`cargo test -p gpui-rhai --lib` — 438 passed (1 new). Clippy clean.
title: feat(context): let scripts read the resolved theme variant
